Aborts when redirect count exceeds max_redirects limit

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { crawl, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { maxRedirects: 2, respectRobotsTxt: false };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await crawl(engine, url);
  console.log(result.redirectCount);
  console.log(result.pages?.[0]?.statusCode);
}

void main();
```
